howItWorks.title: How Rangisha.com Works
howItWorks.subtitle: Three simple, verified steps to recover your property
howItWorks.step1Desc: Submit details of your lost or found item including photos, Rwanda location, and identifying marks.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Our algorithm compares dates, locations, categories, and serial numbers to identify potential matches.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Admin verifies genuine ownership before coordinating a secure handover and processing honest finder rewards.

safety.title: Safety & Fraud Prevention
safety.subtitle: Guidelines to ensure secure and trustworthy item recoveries:
safety.rule1: Never share financial PINs, banking passwords, or OTPs with anyone.
safety.rule2: Do not wire advance payments directly to strangers without admin escrow confirmation.
safety.rule3: Arrange physical handovers in well-lit, public places such as Police Stations or Sector offices.
safety.rule4: Rangisha verifies claimant identification before authorizing handovers.

footer.desc: Rangisha.com is Rwanda's dedicated digital lost and found infrastructure designed to restore peace of mind through transparency and integrity.
